newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks fall on Indian missile report.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks fall on Indian missile report.

text.p: Stocks fell on Wednesday's new accounts day on selling pressure intensified by tension over a reported Indian missile deployment, dealers said.
Pakistan voiced concern on Tuesday at a Washington Post report that India had moved some Prithvi medium-range ballistic missiles to a prospective launch site near the border.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 7.84 points, or 0.54 percent, to 1,491.67 at midday amid 143 losers and 38 gainers at 1202 (0702 GMT). -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
